anna_smirnova.baseline: composed and measured; sits or stands still, moves deliberately, speaks in a low even voice with precise wording, keeps her eyes on the person she talks to
quirks: straightens the papers on her desk before answering a difficult question
removes her glasses and holds them loosely when she is thinking
closes her eyes for a second before making a final decision

reactions.reaction: pauses without changing expression, then answers with one calm, exact sentence that ends the argument
deflects briefly with a small nod and immediately turns the conversation to work
freezes for a moment, sets down whatever she is holding, then asks one short clarifying question

boris_volkov.baseline: restless and expressive; cannot stay still for long, gestures with his whole arms, shifts his weight, speaks fast and loud, face mirrors every emotion immediately
quirks: paces back and forth while reciting his own verses
wraps and unwraps his red scarf when he is nervous
runs a hand through his hair before every bold statement

reactions.reaction: lights up instantly, straightens to his full height and talks twice as fast
flares up defensively, argues back with sweeping gestures, then quickly deflates and becomes sullen and quiet
backs away, voice breaks into a higher pitch, clutches the nearest object with both hands

dmitry_orekhov.baseline: still and economical; makes minimal movements, speaks slowly and quietly with a dry precise tone, watches more than he participates, unhurried even under pressure
quirks: taps his silver cane once, softly, before delivering a verdict-like remark
lets a thin ironic smile replace an answer when he does not want to speak
always removes his hat last, even in a hurry

reactions.reaction: remains perfectly still, answers with one dry short line and a colder smile, never raises his voice
stops moving entirely, lowers his voice further, and studies the other person the way one studies a solved puzzle
a single raised eyebrow is the only visible reaction; he then changes the subject with practiced ease
